text:
zara-cs: FYI AeroThera asks if we can provision a Canada (ca-central) demo route for their gov pilot next Tue 10:00 EST. They need IP allowlist + regional routing and a short-term qps increase to cover test harness. Renewal in 18 days and they tied upsell to pilot latency. Any objections to a 24h exception?
adam-se: Need specifics. How much qps and which IPs? Will this be HTTP host match or direct peering?
zara-cs: They requested +300 qps for 24h, host header match (pilot.aerothera.com), and three IPv4 CIDRs. Auto-revoke after 24h and alert 4h before expiry. CIDRs:
203.0.113.0/24
192.0.2.0/28
198.51.100.64/26
zara-cs: Contact is infra@aerothera.gov, attestation uploaded. They insisted on Canada-only processing for PHI.
kai-sre: Capacity note: +300 qps to ca-central is within burst window but we'll reserve ephemeral pool and enable a per-route token cap. Recommend model fallback to compact if p95 > 400ms.
nora-legal: Confirming: we need their data handling attestation and confirmation that no raw audio/files will be persisted. Also set logs retention to 24h and redact identifiers.
chris-support: Renewal flag: NPS 8 but procurement is slow. Mark renewal_watch and loop commercial for upsell collateral.
adam-se: Draft ops commands (will run after legal signoff):
```
redwood edge allowlist add --region ca-central --cidr 203.0.113.0/24 --account aerothera
redwood edge allowlist add --region ca-central --cidr 192.0.2.0/28 --account aerothera
redwood edge allowlist add --region ca-central --cidr 198.51.100.64/26 --account aerothera
redwood routes create --account aerothera --region ca-central --host "pilot.aerothera.com" --route pilot-ca
redwood quotas update --account aerothera --route pilot-ca --qps +300 --duration 24h --auto-revoke --pre-expiry-alert 4h
redwood logs update --account aerothera --route pilot-ca --redact-payload true --retention 24h
```
kai-sre: Ticket AT-4432 opened and assigned to eng-oncall. deploy-bot: job AT-4432-provision started. ETA ~2h.
chris-support: Commercial contact cc'd: mike.sales@redwood.co to prepare upsell follow.
nora-legal: Attestation looks good; confirmed no files will be persisted. Approve redaction + 24h retention.
kai-sre: Provision complete: allowlist added, route created, qps bump scheduled, auto-revoke set. Audit log attached to AT-4432. smoke test shows p50=110ms p95=360ms. Will enable compact fallback if p95>400ms sustained 3m.
zara-cs: Thanks allI'll schedule the pilot and notify AeroThera to run their harness at 10:00. Please escalate to eng if any anomalies. :pray:
